dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: There's no rush to get to the next battle. It's critical to fully recover your strength if you want to stand the best chance of securing victory.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Why don't we take some time to review the enemy threat and fine-tune our plan of attack?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: In my experience, the more thorough the plan, the sweeter the satisfaction when it all finally comes together.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Even if an enemy is strong enough to fend me off for today, that doesn't faze me. Sooner or later, they will get their comeuppance.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: My vengeance may not always be swift... But it is always final.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: In your case, though... I seriously doubt there are many enemies out there who have what it takes to send you away bearing a grudge.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: What will become of the wicked aristocracy after being ousted by the valiant knights?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Will they flee into the dark woods while the nation rejoices, wallowing in self-pity? Or will they beg for mercy, only to skulk in some corner of the city, sharpening their knives?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Fairytales never answer these questions. They just assume that eternal peace is a given once the villains have been defeated.
